title: Only staff who can lead work orders get a technician group
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Create these staff at this location (Settings > Staff > add staff member > Save), none of them leading any work order:
    • "Esther Howard": role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled here (should show).
    • "Billy Nobill": like Esther but Billable off (should show).
    • "Ina Active": like Esther, then set the staff record inactive (should not show).
    • "Nick Noclock": like Esther but Clockable off (should not show).
    • "Olive Office": like Esther but role Office (should not show).
    • "Tim Clockuser": like Esther but role Time Clock User (should not show).
    • "Ella Elsewhere": like Esther but enrolled only at another location (should not show).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. Read every technician group header.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  6. Read every column header.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Esther Howard and Billy Nobill each have a group in Tech View and a column in Board View, even with no work orders.
  • Ina Active, Nick Noclock, Olive Office, Tim Clockuser and Ella Elsewhere have no group and no column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R7, Terminology, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions 853901313 FF-1 / DR-4.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R7: “Include staff who are Clockable, Active, enrolled in the current location, and whose role is neither Office nor Time Clock User.”
  • Terminology: “A staff member who meets all four criteria: Clockable is enabled; the staff record is Active; their role is neither Office nor Time Clock User; and they are enrolled in the current location. Billable is not a criterion.”
